source: MAFF General Directorate of Agriculture, បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក (Techniques for Banana Cultivation), 2019, table: national banana area and production statistics for 2018
text:
According to national figures cited in the 2019 MAFF banana cultivation manual, banana area and production in Cambodia in 2018 were reported separately for household/family-grown plantings versus company-grown (concession-scale) plantings.

For household plantings: total area planted was about 36,993 hectares, of which about 27,346 hectares were harvested, yielding roughly 352,167 tons of fruit, for an average yield of about 12.88 tons per hectare.

For company plantings: total area planted was about 4,876 hectares, of which about 893 hectares were harvested, yielding roughly 27,248 tons of fruit, for an average yield of about 30.53 tons per hectare.

The gap in yield per hectare between company and household plantings (roughly 30.5 vs. 12.9 tons/ha) reflects the more intensive management, closer spacing control, irrigation, and fertilizer use typical of larger commercial operations compared to smallholder family plots.
